scholarly_quality.concise_summary: The paper provides an extensive, highly structured conceptual architecture coupled with thorough empirical validation spanning theoretical reasoning tasks, public benchmarks, and physical wet-lab/engineering experiments. Controls, comparisons against standard baselines on identical backbone models, and corroborations via physical measurements satisfy scientific rigor standards.

Sage-Taiyi: A Metacognitive Architecture for
Scientific Discovery
Sage-Taiyi Team, Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory
We introduce Sage-Taiyi, a metacognition-inspired architecture that uses accumulated scientific
understanding to guide what to investigate next and how to investigate it. Through explicit moni-
toring and control, the system revises its understanding of evidence, assumptions, and unresolved
questions, then uses these assessments to adapt research targets and select reusable reasoning
methods. On Taiyi-Bench, an AI co-scientist ideation benchmark comprising 265 tasks from 50
papers across ten disciplines, Sage-Taiyi ranks first on all eight metrics of historical rediscovery
and open-ended ideation, achieving an Overall score of 54.0 compared with 47.9 for the strongest
baseline, AI Scientist-v2. It also performs well on two external scientific ideation

Following Nelson and Narens' account of the meta level as maintaining a dynamic model of object-
level cognition [9], the Cognitive State models the current search. It contains two kinds of content.
The first is a selective, source-linked representation of object-level scientific understanding, retain-
ing key findings, competing explanations, necessary assumptions, applicability conditions, and unre-
solved questions. The second consists of monitoring-derived assessments of the evidential status of
key judgments, unresolved conflicts and uncertainties, and dependencies shared across ideas. The
former selectively represents what the system currently understands about the scientific problem;
the latter assesses how this understanding should guide further search. For example, when several
ideas propose different mechanisms but depend on the same untested premise, monitoring records

missing_information: No reproducible review or selection methodology was detected.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Physical measurements in five collaborations (e.g., 84% chemical yield and 342 MPa tensile strength) corroborate the real-world discovery claims independently of the system's internal evaluation signals [E27d3ad59eb0121ce-B0086, E27d3ad59eb0121ce-B0186, E27d3ad59eb0121ce-B0305].
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: The headline benchmark scores are produced through literature-grounded verifiers and human-aligned rubrics on Taiyi-Bench, plus verifier scoring on AgentIdeaBench and IG-Arena [E27d3ad59eb0121ce-B0054, E27d3ad59eb0121ce-B0080].
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Sage-Taiyi's monitoring and control loop uses Cognitive State assessments and the Cognitive Repertoire to select methods and branches, and Taiyi-Optimizer performs surrogate Bayesian optimization over laboratory/simulation conditions [E27d3ad59eb0121ce-B0044, E27d3ad59eb0121ce-B0085].

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: Claims of outperforming prior co-scientist architectures and driving successful discovery iterations are substantiated by both benchmark metric leads and experimental outcomes, such as boosting reaction yields from trace to 84% in carbonylation and achieving 342 MPa tensile strength in cast magnesium alloys [E27d3ad59eb0121ce-B0058, E27d3ad59eb0121ce-B0086, E27d3ad59eb0121ce-B0186, E27d3ad59eb0121ce-B0305].
primary.evaluation_assessment: Evaluation includes controlled benchmarking on 265 tasks against 10 baselines using identical base models (GPT-5.6-Sol) to isolate architectural impact, paired with established benchmarks (AgentIdeaBench, IG-Arena) [E27d3ad59eb0121ce-B0052, E27d3ad59eb0121ce-B0058, E27d3ad59eb0121ce-B0080]. Furthermore, external real-world validation confirms the utility of its proposed designs through physical chemical synthesis, mechanical tensile testing, and high-fidelity aerodynamic and electromagnetic simulations [E27d3ad59eb0121ce-B0186, E27d3ad59eb0121ce-B0192, E27d3ad59eb0121ce-B0297, E27d3ad59eb0121ce-B0305, E27d3ad59eb0121ce-B0309].

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Headline performance claims are corroborated by external automated benchmarks (AgentIdeaBench, IG-Arena) and real-world physical syntheses/tests (isolated chemical yields up to 84% and measured tensile strength of 342 MPa) [E27d3ad59eb0121ce-B0080, E27d3ad59eb0121ce-B0186, E27d3ad59eb0121ce-B0305].
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Final outcomes are assessed via external benchmark rubrics (Taiyi-Bench, AgentIdeaBench, IG-Arena) as well as physical laboratory experiments (wet-lab yields, mechanical tensile tests) and objective physics simulations (CFD, electromagnetic power transmission) [E27d3ad59eb0121ce-B0054, E27d3ad59eb0121ce-B0080, E27d3ad59eb0121ce-B0086].
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Search decisions and candidate selections are guided by meta-level monitoring/control updates based on literature retrieval, heuristic scoring, and surrogate Bayesian optimization via Taiyi-Optimizer [E27d3ad59eb0121ce-B0044, E27d3ad59eb0121ce-B0085].

primary.limitations: The manuscript notes that human expert guidance remains part of selecting candidate directions for physical validation, and tests are limited to specific application spaces with fixed search budgets [E27d3ad59eb0121ce-B0085, E27d3ad59eb0121ce-B0316].
primary.method_assessment: The methodology is comprehensively detailed, formalizing the two-level problem-solving framework with clear mathematical and algorithmic definitions of state updates, monitoring, and control operator selection [E27d3ad59eb0121ce-B0021, E27d3ad59eb0121ce-B0044]. The decomposition into reusable methodological heuristics and cognitive operators across domains is thoroughly motivated and transparently linked to real-world harness execution [E27d3ad59eb0121ce-B0028, E27d3ad59eb0121ce-B0044, E27d3ad59eb0121ce-B0085].
primary.quality_rationale: The paper provides an extensive, highly structured conceptual architecture coupled with thorough empirical validation spanning theoretical reasoning tasks, public benchmarks, and physical wet-lab/engineering experiments. Controls, comparisons against standard baselines on identical backbone models, and corroborations via physical measurements satisfy scientific rigor standards.
primary.scoped_contribution: Sage-Taiyi is a metacognitive multi-agent architecture for scientific discovery that pairs object-level scientific search (Target Tree, Idea Graph, Evidence State) with meta-level regulation (Cognitive State, Cognitive Repertoire, and monitoring/control loops) [E27d3ad59eb0121ce-B0009, E27d3ad59eb0121ce-B0011, E27d3ad59eb0121ce-B0014]. It demonstrates strong performance on the new Taiyi-Bench benchmark across 265 tasks, validates on AgentIdeaBench and IG-Arena, and supports five real-world laboratory and simulation discoveries in chemistry, metamaterials, alloy design, and compressor engineering [E27d3ad59eb0121ce-B0058, E27d3ad59eb0121ce-B0080, E27d3ad59eb0121ce-B0086].

scholarly_quality.rationale: The paper provides an extensive, highly structured conceptual architecture coupled with thorough empirical validation spanning theoretical reasoning tasks, public benchmarks, and physical wet-lab/engineering experiments. Controls, comparisons against standard baselines on identical backbone models, and corroborations via physical measurements satisfy scientific rigor standards.
scholarly_quality.uncertainty: The manuscript notes that human expert guidance remains part of selecting candidate directions for physical validation, and tests are limited to specific application spaces with fixed search budgets [E27d3ad59eb0121ce-B0085, E27d3ad59eb0121ce-B0316].

limitations_or_uncertainty.value: Structured research-card claims use title, abstract/summary, metadata, screening rules, and curation. A separate scholarly-quality assessment used bounded full-text excerpts, but unsupported claim, method, or evidence fields remain unextracted.
